item.title: Cyberattack strikes every 39 seconds worldwide, UAE Cybersecurity Council warns

item.title: Dubai Police warn public against fake recruitment ads on social media
item.description: Dubai Police have issued a new warning about fraudulent recruitment advertisements circulating on social media, falsely offering domestic worker and auxiliary staff placement services. item.title: UAE tightens rules on endangered species, agriculture imports
item.description: The UAE government has revamped its environmental and agricultural legal framework, introducing a suite of federal laws aimed at cracking down on the illegal trade of endangered species and enhancing national biosecurity. item.title: Philippine Embassy warns: J-1 visa does not lead to US citizenship
item.description: The Philippine Embassy in Washington DC has reminded Filipino nationals that the J-1 exchange visitor program visa is a nonimmigrant visa and does not provide a pathway to permanent residency or US citizenship.
